description: This file defines a PHP class 'Reward' within the OpenCart admin extension, specifically under the 'total' category. It contains methods for rendering the reward total configuration page and saving its settings, as well as managing interface components like breadcrumbs, headers, and permissions.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the reward total extension configuration in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the reward total configuration page in the admin interface, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading necessary subviews before outputting the page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the reward total extension settings via AJAX, with permission checks, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
